div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://bih-cei.github.io/PCOR-MII/CodeSystem/ansocq-koerperteile defines the following codes:

tr.td: There is no way I would be prepared to gain weight on these body parts.

I have decided that I am prepared to gain weight on these body parts.
I am presently trying to gain weight on these body parts.
I am working to maintain the weight I gained on these body parts.
